title: Fig Tidies the Compost Heap
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations i as igh, o as oa, o as u, u as oo.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar standing proudly beside a tidy, rounded compost heap in the garden.
A strong wind and rain sweeping across the dark garden at night.
The compost heap scattered with wet leaves, twigs and bits of straw, all out of order.
Fig the caterpillar looking at the scattered, untidy compost heap in the early morning light.
Fig the caterpillar carefully gathering up wet twigs one at a time.
Fig the caterpillar placing a neat stack of twigs back onto the compost heap.
Fig the caterpillar spotting one last flat stone hidden under the scattered pile.
Fig the caterpillar tucking the stone neatly into the side of the heap.
The compost heap now neat and rounded once more, no mess in sight.
Fig the caterpillar sitting back, satisfied, beside the restored tidy heap.
